text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since her miraculous recovery, the name Yukoma Onsen rapidly drew widespread attention...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oho, hot spring recuperation.
It was great back in the day, but to think it's evolved this much.
I should take the kids on my team for a nice refresh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It works on sprains too.
Daily body care is essential, after all.
Let's go check it out before it gets worse!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
A very warm welcome to you all!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Boy, it's busy.
Not just our place, all the other inns
must be in utter chaos too.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Man, what incredible publicity! All we wanted was for folks to cheer up, but that girl... she really outdid herself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The hot springs resort was overflowing with countless Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing, resting, and recovering from injuries.
Every girl comes here for different reasons.
Yet in the end, they all—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so much!
My ankle's totally fine now!
I'll give it my all at the academy again starting tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
I am glad to hear that.
It brings me great joy to have been of help.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Truly...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please come visit us anytime.
Next time, preferably before you get injured.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Landlady, it's already break time, you know?
You've been like this all the time lately. Aren't you tired?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"You're a hundred years too early to be worrying about my health.
I take perfect care of my own condition."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, my apologies for that.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Landlady.
Everyone's leaving with a smile on their face, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone's so full of energy.
Full of energy, and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: This is the kinda view I always wanted to see...

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, excuse me, Trainer over there.
Is Hoshina-san's inn around here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we speak, I notice the badge on his lapel.
If I recall correctly, that's worn by
high-ranking officials in the URA...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well...? You were here!
And here I thought it was just a reservation with the same name."

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer Hoshina!
Wait, no, you're the proprietress now!
Brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
I came here partly for an inspection!
I figured there are some things you only notice
when you experience them as a guest.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we did receive an inquiry from the URA.
They wanted their younger staff to tour our facilities.

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text: "Headquarters is focusing on it again now. It seemed user numbers dropped a few years ago, but..."

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Now that the business situation has improved,
we should increase subsidies and expand the facilities further—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really...!
Does that mean we don't have to shut down the inn?!

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if there is anything else you need,
please let me know,
and we shall discuss it in council.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that true?
How truly grateful I am.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make even better use of
the hot spring that you and the others
dug out for us, <username>!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
We want to expand the sauna and rest areas, and hire more staff too...♪
Right, Proprietress?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
There's an endless amount of things needed for the Umamusume, after all.
